title: Little Thomas
overview: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

title: Bokshi
overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

title: Peter Rebello
overview: Thriller/ Drama

title: Prem Keetanu
overview: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: Pooja Meri Jaan
overview: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

title: Reporting Live
overview: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

title: Udta Teer
overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

title: Nayyi Navelli
overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

title: Prahaar - The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: Ramayana
overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: V. Shantaram
overview: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

title: Gunmaaster G9
overview: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
overview: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

title: Eetha
overview: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

title: The Alfred Eulogy
overview: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.

title: King
overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

title: The Audition
overview: A struggling actor, Nikhil Dagga , 31 stands at the brink of surrender. Broke and beaten down, he retreats to a claustrophobic Mumbai apartment where intrusive neighbors and mounting debts test his resolve. When his final chance at redemption collapses, one desperate, late-night performance becomes an unexpected act of rebellion.

title: Mouthwashing : The Film
overview: The Indian Film Adaptation Of The Bone-Chilling Video Game - Mouthwashing

title: Golmaal 5
overview: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.

title: Love & War
overview: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.

title: Naagzilla
overview: In a world where shape-shifting Ichhadhaari naags have been living amongst humans, chaos ensues when a once carefree Ichhadhaari naag's Naagmani and his life are threatened by a wily, power- hungry villain.

title: BAHUBURA
overview: Mr. Teacher, a quiet and principled schoolteacher, is devastated after losing his only child in a tragic road accident. The very same day, at the accident site, he comes across another injured boy-abandoned, nameless, and unconscious. Everyone around looks the other way, but Mr. Teacher steps in to help. As he nurses the boy back to health, he discovers the child is a victim of a deeper evil-caught in the clutches of a trafficking network. What begins as an act of kindness becomes a mission of justice.

title: Khaali
overview: The film explores the emptiness of 19-year-old boy named as Naveen. The person who doesn't know what do in his life. The story explores the topic by showing the relationship between the parents and the child.

title: Dada - The Sourav Ganguly Story
overview: A biopic on former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly.

title: Mahavatar
overview: Mahavatar tells the epic story of Parashurama, the immortal warrior of dharma from Hindu mythology, whose journey spans ages as he upholds righteousness against the forces of darkness.
